desc: Derive and verify the fixed-element contribution, including suffix subset selection and prefix/suffix ordering multiplicities.
Group \(1,\ldots,N\) by decimal digit length and express subset weights using class counts and powers of \(10\).
Develop an \(O(NL)\) aggregation over distinguished elements using class totals, avoiding per-element recomputation.
Prove the formula on small cases such as \(N=1,2,3\).
Implement the stdin/stdout Python solution with factorials and modular arithmetic, then run the provided sample tests.
